PHBMeasurement.description: One source's brightness in one band.

BAND_ID.description: Band identifier; resolves to a `$PHB` BAND_ID.

SPECTRAL_REGIME.description:
Coarse region of the band, copied from its descriptor so a consumer
can select a mode without resolving the band.

WAVELENGTH_EFF_NM.description:
Effective wavelength of the band, nanometres (vacuum). Copied from the
descriptor; required for synthesis when the descriptor is not at hand.

MAGNITUDE_SYSTEM.description: Calibration system when QUANTITY is MAGNITUDE.

UNCERTAINTY.description: One-sigma uncertainty of VALUE, same units.

EPOCH_MJD.description:
Mid-time of the observation, Modified Julian Date (TT), for sources
whose brightness varies. Absent for a catalogue mean.

OBSERVATION_COUNT.description: Number of observations averaged into VALUE; 0 when unstated.

PHB.description: Photometric Band: one passband's place on the spectrum and its calibration.

BAND_ID.description:
Stable band identifier, unique within the publishing catalogue, e.g.
"V", "Ks", "0.5-2keV", "1.4GHz". Measurements refer to it.

SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Name of the photometric system the band belongs to, as the defining
publication states it.

WAVELENGTH_MIN_NM.description: Short edge of the band at half maximum response, nanometres.

WAVELENGTH_MAX_NM.description: Long edge of the band at half maximum response, nanometres.

MAGNITUDE_SYSTEM.description: Calibration system of magnitudes stated in the band.

ZERO_POINT_JY.description:
Flux density at the effective wavelength of a zero-magnitude source,
janskys.

RESPONSE_WAVELENGTH_NM.description: Wavelengths the response curve is sampled at, nanometres, ascending.

RESPONSE.description:
Relative system response at each RESPONSE_WAVELENGTH_NM sample,
peak-normalised to 1. Photon-counting unless RESPONSE_IS_ENERGY.

RESPONSE_IS_ENERGY.description: True when RESPONSE is an energy-counting response.

CITATION.description: Reference to the publication that defines the band.

DEFINITION_URL.description: URL of the band's defining document or response table.

CSO.description: Celestial Source: a non-stellar source or transient, with position and multi-band brightness.

ID.description: Stable identifier, equal across every revision of one source.

DESIGNATIONS.description: Other designations, each in the form its catalogue uses.

CLASS_NAME.description: Producer's class name when SOURCE_CLASS is OTHER, or a finer subclass.

MESSENGER.description: Carrier the source was detected in.

POSITION_EPOCH.description: Epoch of RA and DEC, Julian years (TT).

POS_ERR_MAJOR_ARCSEC.description: Semi-major axis of the localisation ellipse, arcseconds.

POS_ERR_MINOR_ARCSEC.description: Semi-minor axis of the localisation ellipse, arcseconds.

POS_ERR_PA_DEG.description: Position angle of the major axis, degrees east of north.

POS_ERR_CONFIDENCE.description: Probability contained in the ellipse, (0, 1), e.g. 0.9.

LOCALIZATION_LAYER_ID.description:
LAYER_ID of the `$SKT` probability-map tiles that localise the source,
when an ellipse cannot.

PMRA.description: Proper motion in RA times cos(DEC), milliarcseconds per year.

PMDEC.description: Proper motion in DEC, milliarcseconds per year.

DISTANCE_MPC.description:
Luminosity distance, megaparsecs, when stated directly (as for a
gravitational-wave candidate).

SIZE_MAJOR_ARCSEC.description:
Angular size of an extended source: major axis, arcseconds. Absent for
a point source.

SIZE_PA_DEG.description: Position angle of the major axis, degrees east of north.

IS_TRANSIENT.description:
True when the source is a transient or flaring episode rather than a
persistent source.

EVENT_TIME.description: Trigger or peak time, ISO 8601 UTC.

START_TIME.description: Start of the activity, ISO 8601 UTC.

END_TIME.description: End of the activity, ISO 8601 UTC.

DURATION_T90_S.description: Duration containing 90% of the fluence, seconds.

PERIOD_S.description: Period of a periodic source (rotation, orbit, pulsation), seconds.

PERIOD_DERIVATIVE.description: First time derivative of PERIOD_S, seconds per second.

FALSE_ALARM_RATE_PER_YR.description: False-alarm rate of the detection, per year.

ALERT_REVISION.description: Revision number of this record for its ID, from 0.

ISSUED_TIME.description: Time this revision was issued, ISO 8601 UTC.

SOURCE_CATALOG.description: Verbatim name of the catalogue or alert stream the record came from.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publisher asks for.
